report_issue_clusters.observed:
FinishState has no explicit declaration. Its first mention is PlantUML line 21: `cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` inside the HighwayMode block, so PlantUML declares it as a child of HighwayMode. It is also used from outside that block: PlantUML line 38: `lane_change_urban --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<0.7`; PlantUML line 46: `UrbanMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`. In the closed model those transitions enter HighwayMode and are routed to its child FinishState.

Consequences observed in the same closed model (folded sub-claims, each an obligation settled by this root cause): (1) HighwayMode does not stably terminate: HighwayMode has a reachable self-transition guarded by R45RouteToken == 20, and FinishState has outgoing auto_finished_true and urban_way_true transitions.
